comment: v8 = v7 with the onset gate CORRECTED (2026-08-18, sixth round): the v7
overshoot gate was wrong methodology - overshoot of any size/length is
normal attack shape (brass!) and must never gate (it wrongly demoted E5).
The real Gs5 defect is a QUICK blip mid-onset: two-sided flank-extrapolation
detector (knees and swells score 0), normalized to the onset region own
p90 (steady-region vibrato is not a fair reference). Bars: 2.5dB AND 2x
